crossRefs.note: “After that you will come to the hill of God, where the garrison of the Philistines is; and it will happen, when you…
Let our lord now command your servants who are in front of you to seek out a man who is a skillful player on the harp.…
But now bring me a musician.” When the musician played, Yahweh’s hand came on him.
David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: David and all the house of Israel played before Yahweh with all kinds of instruments made of cypress wood, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with castanets, and with cymbals.
translations.bsb: David and all the house of Israel were celebrating before the LORD with all kinds of wood instruments, harps, stringed instruments, tambourines, sistrums, and cymbals.
translations.kjv: And David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD on all manner of instruments made of fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.
translations.asv: And David and all the house of Israel played before Jehovah with all manner of instruments made of fir-wood, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with castanets, and with cymbals.
